run_evaluate_tta: run test-time augmented evaluation on a detection model with multi-scale inputs and soft NMS
run_filter_boxes: run box filtering to keep detections within a specified min and max scale range
test_evaluate_tta: test the TTA evaluation function with a detection model, dataloader, and COCO evaluator
test_filter_boxes: test the filter_boxes function with a tensor of boxes and scale thresholds
refactor_evaluate_tta: refactor evaluate_tta to support configurable scale ranges instead of hardcoded SCALE_RANGES_DICT
